_doc: AI teammates (T-031). Tuning for gravelight/bots/*.gd; pure rules in bot_config.gd, unit-tested in gravelight/tests/unit/test_bots.gd.

spawn_kit._doc: What every bot spawns with, on top of the start pistol: the guns in `weapons` (the one in `hold` goes into its hands) and the perks in `perks`, free and outside the power rule. Ironhide Stout is the Juggernog equivalent (250 health), Second Wind Schnapps the Quick Revive equivalent (2x revive speed). restore_after_down gives the kit perks back when the bot is revived or respawns (co-op loses every perk on going down); weapons come back on a respawn.

local_ai._doc: One bot (squad index bot_index) gets a planner that picks its objective: the map's easter egg steps, the power, doors, perks, guns, the Crucible, boards, or sticking with the team. In mode 'local' a local LLM served by Ollama (endpoint) makes the pick every decide_every_s from a short text summary of the match and a numbered option list (structured JSON output, the option ids as an enum); the first installed model in `models` is used and kept loaded for keep_alive. When Ollama is unreachable, slow (timeout_s) or answers nonsense, the scripted planner (each option's own score) decides instead, so the bot never stalls. autostart_ollama runs `ollama serve` (hidden) when the API is down and the exe is found. The bot then roams the whole map for its objectives (no leash) and fights from where it stands. speak: the LLM's short remark as a subtitle in the bot's voice, at most every speak_cooldown_s.

scaling._doc: Each bot counts as this many players for zombie counts, the Foreman's health and the Bellringer count (rounded, capped at 4). 1.0 = exactly like a human teammate.

kill_share._doc: When the human has fewer than human_min_share of the last window kills (once min_sample kills are logged), bots leave zombies the human is aiming at alone unless they threaten someone.

combat._doc: window_target_priority raises zombies at windows; a bot backs away from anything closer than backpedal_radius_m while it shoots; melee_range_m is the knife; danger_radius_m / crowd_count / flee_hp_frac decide when it kites instead.

shopping._doc: What a bot spends its own Scrip on between fights, within max_from_leader_m of the leader: wall guns from the wishlist (best affordable first, keeping weapon_buffer_scrip), ammo for a held gun under ammo_below_frac, up to max_perks cheap perks from perk_min_round, doors (see doors) and the Crucible upgrade (see crucible).

doors._doc: Bots buy closed doors: enabled, when scrip >= cost + reserve_scrip, at least round_delay_s after the round started, at most max_per_round_per_bot per bot per round; the door the human is looking at (within human_look_cone_deg) or nearest to is preferred (near_bonus_m - distance), within max_from_leader_m of the leader. Doors needing the power wait for it.

crucible._doc: The Crucible when the map has one: from min_round, with the upgrade price + reserve_scrip in hand, a bot feeds a gun that can learn something (the one in hand first), waits out the forge in front of it (shooting from there if it must) and takes its own result; never a teammate's. Only in the round break when only_in_break, never while the human is down; priority is its errand score (above boards 30, ammo 60). Upgraded ammo for the upgraded gun in hand under ammo_below_frac when the ammo price + ammo_reserve_scrip is in hand.
